hoverboard_store.title: Shipping and Delivery Times
hoverboard_store.content: For our Hoverboard UK Store, standard shipping takes 2 to 3 business days within the UK. Next-day delivery is available at checkout for orders placed before 2 PM GMT.

hoverboard_store.title: Return Policy & Refunds
hoverboard_store.content: Hoverboard Store offers a 30-day return policy. Hoverboards must be unused, in their original packaging, and with all accessories. To initiate a return, email returns@hoverboardstore.co.uk.

hoverboard_store.title: Battery and Charging Safety
hoverboard_store.content: Always charge your hoverboard on a hard, flat surface in a well-ventilated room. Do not leave the hoverboard charging unattended or overnight. Only use the UL-certified charger provided with your purchase.

hcs_gadgets.title: Warranty Policy
hcs_gadgets.content: At HCS Gadgets, we provide a 12-month manufacturer warranty covering technical defects. The warranty does not cover accidental water damage or physical drops.

hcs_gadgets.title: Returns and Technical Diagnostics
hcs_gadgets.content: Faulty gadgets can be sent back to our laboratory for diagnostics within 14 days of purchase. If a defect is verified, we will cover the return postage and issue a replacement or refund.

aroma_haven.title: Essential Oils Usage Guidelines
aroma_haven.content: Aroma Haven essential oils are 100% pure and highly concentrated. Always dilute them with a carrier oil before applying to the skin. Do not ingest, and keep diffusers out of reach of cats and dogs as some oils can be toxic.

aroma_haven.title: Shipping and Packaging Fragility
aroma_haven.content: We package all essential oil bottles in biodegradable bubble sleeves. If an item arrives leaked or broken, take a photo and contact support@aromahaven.co.uk within 48 hours for an immediate replacement.
